review: P4-B0 independent authentication security and counterexample review
reviewed_state: Uncommitted B0 authentication implementation on baseline; no implementation edits by reviewer

scope.user_state_read: P4-B namespace in feature-list.json, persisted progress tail, current status and log

strengths: Production and development default to required authentication; testing alone does not bypass it, and legacy_test is explicitly restricted to testing.
Both JSON and SSE request dependencies use the actual verifier, reject conflicting body user IDs before dispatch and replace anonymous identity with the server subject.
Admin endpoints use the authenticated server role; old x-admin-token and client role/proxy headers cannot promote required-mode users.
Strict registry envelope, duplicate JSON keys/digests, schema fields, role names, boolean revocation, UTC time bounds and size/row bounds fail closed.
Server minting uses cryptographic randomness and persists only the SHA256 digest; expiry and not_before are checked on each authentication call.
Malformed registry errors and ordinary auth failures do not expose registry text or incoming credentials.

validation.command: conda run --no-capture-output -n adaptive-rag python -m pytest tests/unit/test_p4b_auth_review.py -q --basetemp .scratch/p4b-auth-review-green --junitxml=research/docs/agent_engineering_upgrade/p4_dependency_integration/evidence/b0_independent_review_green.xml
validation.warnings: One existing langgraph checkpoint pending deprecation warning
validation.method: httpx ASGITransport against real create_app and actual Authenticator. No fake Principal/dependency override of auth; recording business service supplied through get_container only. Lifespan intentionally not entered. All test-time socket connection methods prohibited after Windows asyncio framework socketpair setup.
coverage: Missing, proxy-only, combined and duplicate authorization headers on chat and SSE
Tab, trailing whitespace and oversized bearer token rejection on chat and SSE
Conflicting body subject blocked and omitted identity bound before chat/SSE service dispatch
Client-supplied role/subject fields and proxy identity cannot alter verified identity
Both admin endpoints reject old admin token without Bearer and reject verified user plus forged admin headers
Both admin endpoints accept a registry-provisioned admin credential
Public liveness does not dispatch business work
not_before exact equality accepted; expiry exact equality rejected; same authenticator rechecks clock
Non-UTC/naive/invalid interval, coerced revoked field, unknown role and extra fields safely rejected
Duplicate token digest, 257 rows, boolean version, nested duplicate JSON key and byte bound safely rejected
Testing environment alone remains required and an empty registry denies access
Operator mint round-trip returns a verifiable credential and stores no raw token in registry entry

initial_review_harness_failure.cause: Review socket guard initially blocked Windows asyncio's internal loopback socketpair while constructing/cleaning its event loop; these were fixture errors, not authentication failures.
initial_review_harness_failure.correction: Construct event_loop fixture before applying the connection prohibition and restore connection functions before its teardown.

considered_and_set_aside.reason: Explicit design selects small operator-provisioned API credentials; this review does not claim identity-provider verification.

considered_and_set_aside.behavior: Hot registry reload and immediate distributed revocation
considered_and_set_aside.reason: Plan explicitly documents restart-based registry reload and per-request expiry. No hot-reload claim is accepted.

considered_and_set_aside.behavior: TLS termination and credential delivery/storage by deployment operators
considered_and_set_aside.reason: Required deployment controls are documented; no actual deployed infrastructure is authorized for this Windows review.

considered_and_set_aside.reason: ASGI recording-service tests prove the auth boundary only. The separately implemented required-auth Uvicorn matrix must supply actual HTTP/business evidence.

considered_and_set_aside.behavior: PostgreSQL/Redis/Qdrant integration and distributed pending confirmations
considered_and_set_aside.reason: B2/B3 are explicitly deferred to user-restored Ubuntu. These tests do not constitute real-service or multi-worker readiness.

considered_and_set_aside.behavior: Existing public metrics, capabilities and documentation routes
considered_and_set_aside.reason: No business/admin write or user identity trust was added there; health remains intentionally public. Deployment exposure policy is outside the authorized B0 auth change.

assessment.reason: No critical, important or minor implementation defect identified in this bounded independent review; 33 counterexamples pass with the actual verifier. This evidence alone does not satisfy the required real HTTP/business matrix or authorize Ubuntu B2/B3.
